g.text: urban mislabelled as soil (map gap): urban recall
Random forests on synthetic 8-band pixels of six classes (water, vegetation, soil, urban, snow, cloud). (a) Pool of 12 000 unlabelled pixels, 5 000 test pixels;
start with 5 labels per class, add 30 per round; margin sampling labels the pixels whose two most likely classes are closest; mean and +/-1 s.d. of 4 runs. (b) 4 000
training pixels; 'random' replaces a label by another class at random; 'map gap' relabels urban pixels as soil, as when buildings are missing from a reference map;
